mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% annualized over the previous 3 months signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns remain positive in > 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL annualized increase exceeds 2%.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5 percentage points over the previous 3 months signals weakening labor market conditions, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns remain positive in > 55% of instances where UNRATE increases by more than 0.5pp.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in housing starts (HOUST) by more than 5% over the previous 6 months signals a weakening demand in the housing sector, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns remain positive in > 60% of instances where HOUST declines by more than 5%.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% over the previous 3 months signals strengthening supply-side conditions, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns remain negative in > 40% of instances where INDPRO increases by more than 1%.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals a loosening monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns remain negative in > 40% of instances following a decrease in FEDFUNDS.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) and a decrease in unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals strengthening consumer demand and labor market conditions, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
regime_hint: strong consumer demand and labor market
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns remain negative in > 40% of instances where RSAFS increases and UNRATE decreases.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 200,000 over the previous month signals a strong labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns remain negative in > 40% of instances where PAYEMS increases by more than 200,000.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real GDP (GDPC1) by more than 2% over the previous 6 months signals a strong economic expansion, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns remain negative in > 40% of instances where GDPC1 increases by more than 2%.
